title: Borderline Ovarian Tumors (LMP) & Fertility Preservation: Histology, Peritoneal Implants and Fertility Surgery
subject: ss-gynaecological-oncology
refs: Berek & Hacker's Gynecologic Oncology 7th Edition Ch 15
DiSaia and Creasman Clinical Gynecologic Oncology 10th Edition Ch 11
ESGO Consensus Guidelines on Borderline Ovarian Tumors

steps.say: Borderline ovarian tumors, also termed tumors of low malignant potential, represent distinct epithelial neoplasms characterized by cellular proliferation without destructive stromal invasion.
steps.tx: Borderline ovarian tumors (**BOT / LMP**) are defined histopathologically by epithelial stratification, nuclear atypia, and mitotic activity with an unequivocal **absence of destructive stromal invasion**. They account for **15-20% of ovarian epithelial tumors**, presenting at a significantly younger reproductive age than invasive carcinomas.

steps.say: Borderline ovarian tumors divide into two predominant histopathological types with divergent genetic pathways, clinical patterns, and recurrence risks.
steps.tx: **Serous borderline tumors (SBT)** frequently present bilaterally (in 25-30% of cases) and are driven by activating **KRAS or BRAF mutations**. Conversely, **mucinous borderline tumors (MBT)** are typically massive, strictly **unilateral MBT (>95%)**, and follow an intestinal-type or endocervical-like histological differentiation.

rows: Activating mutations in KRAS or BRAF (V600E)
Present in up to 35% (non-invasive or invasive)
Extremely rare; suspect appendiceal primary if present
CEA and CA 19-9 elevated; CA-125 normal

steps.say: The nature of extra-ovarian peritoneal implants represents the single most important determinant of prognosis in advanced-stage serous borderline tumors.
steps.tx: Extra-ovarian peritoneal lesions in serous BOT are strictly categorized into **non-invasive implants** (epithelial cells resting on mesothelium without stromal invasion; excellent prognosis with **overall survival >95%**) and **invasive implants**, which demonstrate destructive stromal infiltration, poorer disease-free survival, and are now classified as low-grade serous carcinoma.

left.title: Non-Invasive Implants (True BOT)
points: Desmoplastic or epithelial clusters lying on peritoneal surfaces
No destructive infiltration of underlying fat or subperitoneal stroma

right.title: Invasive Implants (Low-Grade Serous Carcinoma)
points: Haphazard infiltrating micropapillary clusters or single cells
Clear destructive penetration into underlying stroma
Associated with progressive disease and late mortality

steps.say: In reproductive-aged women who strongly desire future childbearing, conservative fertility-sparing surgery represents the standard of care for borderline ovarian tumors.
steps.tx: For reproductive-aged patients, conservative surgical management entails **fertility-sparing unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy** (**USO**) or ovarian cystectomy. While cystectomy carries a higher local **recurrence in remaining ovary (10-15%)**, repeat salvage surgery is uniformly successful, preserving childbearing with no adverse impact on overall survival.

nodes.label: Diagnose borderline ovarian tumor in reproductive-aged woman
Perform unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy (preferred) or careful cystectomy
Achieve complete staging without injuring contralateral healthy ovary
Monitor with serial pelvic ultrasound; treat isolated ovarian recurrences conservatively

steps.say: Complete surgical staging is recommended for borderline tumors to accurately detect occult peritoneal implants and establish definitive prognosis.
steps.tx: Comprehensive surgical staging includes peritoneal washings, multiple peritoneal biopsies, infracolic omentectomy, and resection of macroscopic lesions. Systematic **omission of routine lymphadenectomy** is supported by extensive evidence, as nodal involvement occurs in <5% and lymphadenectomy **does not improve survival**. Multidisciplinary tumour board review ensures optimal clinical staging and coordinates tailored surgical oncological interventions.

left.title: Essential Staging Steps
points: Peritoneal cytology via aspirate or washings
Infracolic omentectomy and multiple peritoneal biopsies
Complete surgical resection of all visible peritoneal implants

right.title: Omitted Surgical Steps
points: Routine pelvic and para-aortic lymphadenectomy is omitted
No routine biopsy of normal-appearing contralateral ovary
No bowel resection unless required for mechanical obstruction

steps.say: In patients presenting with mucinous ovarian borderline tumors, careful inspection of the appendix is mandatory to exclude a gastrointestinal primary.
steps.tx: Routine **appendectomy in mucinous BOT** is mandatory whenever bilateral ovarian involvement, pseudomyxoma peritonei, or right-sided mucinous lesions are encountered. This step is essential to **exclude appendiceal primary** adenocarcinoma with secondary ovarian metastasis, which frequently mimics primary ovarian mucinous neoplasia. Multidisciplinary tumour board review ensures optimal clinical staging and coordinates tailored surgical oncological interventions.

nodes.label: Encounter large mucinous ovarian neoplasm at laparotomy or laparoscopy
Inspect entire gastrointestinal tract, especially ileocecal valve and appendix
Perform concurrent appendectomy and send for frozen section
Differentiate primary ovarian MBT from metastatic appendiceal adenocarcinoma

steps.say: Conventional cytotoxic chemotherapy is ineffective against borderline ovarian tumors and should not be administered even in advanced-stage disease.
steps.tx: Because borderline tumor cells display low mitotic activity, there is a clear **lack of benefit from cytotoxic chemo**. Prospective trials demonstrate that conventional platinum-based chemotherapy confers **no survival advantage** even in Stage II-III disease with non-invasive implants, while subjecting patients to unnecessary toxicities.

left.title: Chemotherapy Inefficacy
points: Borderline tumor cells are slow-growing with low proliferative index
Zero documented overall survival benefit in randomized cohorts

right.title: Recommended Management Strategy
points: Maximal complete surgical cytoreduction of implants
Watchful observation with serial CA-125 and pelvic ultrasound
Secondary cytoreductive surgery for macroscopic recurrences

steps.say: Micropapillary serous borderline tumors represent an aggressive histological variant that bridges borderline disease with low-grade serous carcinoma.
steps.tx: The **micropapillary serous borderline (SBT-MP)** variant is characterized by filiform micropapillae lacking fibrovascular cores (>=5 mm continuous length). It carries a significantly **increased invasive recurrence** risk and **progression to low-grade serous carcinoma (LGSC)**, requiring vigilant long-term surveillance. Multidisciplinary tumour board review ensures optimal clinical staging and coordinates tailored surgical oncological interventions.
